note: Baseline counts are Sonar observations, not counts of resolved issues. No issues have been manually closed, accepted or suppressed. No deployment, commit or push was performed.

rules.name: String literals should not be duplicated
rules.work: 76 named constants replace 545 occurrences with identical values. Two multiline SQL fragment families retain distinct whitespace and still need query-level refactoring.

rules.name: Function names should comply with a naming convention
rules.work: 21 declaration spellings normalized using PHP case-insensitive callable identity. Underscore and digit renames remain pending to preserve legacy callers.

rules.name: Generic exceptions should not be thrown
rules.work: Domain exceptions preserve the original RuntimeException/Exception inheritance and existing catch behavior.

rules.name: Source code should comply with formatting standards
rules.work: Horizontal parenthesis spacing, for/foreach separators and merged conditions cleaned up. Remaining multiline argument layout needs analyzer verification.

rules.name: Local variable and function parameter names should comply with a naming convention
rules.work: Token-based variable renames applied across the reported modules. Legacy verifyItemExists($ID, ...) is preserved.

rules.name: Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
rules.work: Extracted allocator collision retry, binary filename splitting, trigger action merging and gzip copying. Large query, tree, media and duplication functions remain pending.

rules.name: Functions should not contain too many return statements
rules.work: Reduced returns in the six group writers, checkType, time comparisons and gzip compression. Security guards and other legacy functions remain pending.

rules.name: Tabulation characters should not be used
rules.work: Whitespace/comment tabs expanded. Literal tabs escaped while retaining the exact decoded string values.

rules.name: empty() should be used to test for emptiness
rules.work: Reported array count comparisons changed to empty/nonempty checks.

rules.name: Mergeable if statements should be combined
rules.work: Merged all 20 reported nested conditions with short-circuit order retained.

rules.name: Track uses of TODO tags
rules.work: Three unreachable placeholders in checkType replaced with documented pass-through behavior. Product decisions and feature/optimization tasks remain explicit.

rules.name: Functions should not have too many parameters
rules.work: Requires compatibility-preserving internal APIs; positional/reference/named callers must be reviewed per function.

rules.name: Sections of code should not be commented out
rules.work: Removed 17 reported disabled-code sections (21 comment tokens).

rules.name: && and || should be used
rules.work: All 16 reported operators were inside conditions; replaced without changing assignment precedence.

rules.name: Local variables should not be declared and then immediately returned or thrown
rules.work: Direct return expressions replace temporary bindings.

rules.name: Unused local variables should be removed
rules.work: Removed unused bindings; retained metadata calls that can have effects or errors.

rules.name: Boolean literals should not be redundant
rules.work: Removed loose truthiness comparisons; strict false checks retain their semantics.

rules.name: Unused assignments should be removed
rules.work: Removed six overwritten write results and the redundant tree-path assignment.

rules.name: Unused function parameters should be removed
rules.work: Removed buildRootNode client/order parameters and the unused internal deleteDescendants parent type. cURL callback position and the public binary writer parameter remain for compatibility.

rules.name: Lines should not end with trailing whitespaces
rules.work: Token-preserving whitespace cleanup and git diff --check pass.

rules.name: Jump statements should not be redundant
rules.work: Removed the final redundant continue in the v1 update route. Two property reader fallbacks are now explicit return null for consistent value returns.

rules.name: Regular expression quantifiers and character classes should be used concisely
rules.work: Reported ASCII digit character classes replaced by equivalent digit escapes.

rules.name: Functions should use return consistently
rules.work: Property readers explicitly return null on empty/error paths.

rules.name: Redundant pairs of parentheses should be removed
rules.work: Removed the reported double wrappers in query debug and legacy item filtering.

rules.name: switch statements should have at least 3 case clauses
rules.work: The user lookup switch is now an equivalent if/else.

rules.name: Functions should not have too many lines of code
rules.work: duplicateItem needs staged extraction with descendant/shared-child behavior tests.

rules.name: Methods should not be empty
rules.work: Documented the intentionally reserved legacy setGlobalVariable entry point.

rules.name: Two branches should not have exactly the same implementation
rules.work: Grouped identifier/identifiers initialization cases.
